$comment: First-person claims still written literally in niche copy (src/). Each one is true for the current owner; a new owner checks it, then rewrites or deletes it. Claims that moved to src/person/config.ts (firstName, pronouns, stack, profession, seniority, careerLine, experienceShort, credentials, originStories, contactFeedsCrm, supportHours) are not listed here, and src/person/ itself is never scanned (it is the new owner's own data). `npm run review:copy` reports which phrases are still present (and which entries are stale); `--strict` exits 1 while any is present. kind: claim = a fact about the owner; tools = names tools the owner works in; stance = a working principle (fine to keep if it is yours); positioning = how the niche introduces the owner; metric = a measured figure or measurement date of the owner's own project, literal in a niche angle; project-wording = the owner's project described literally in a niche angle (prints for anyone who registers a project with that id).
